segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the updated quote for 48 seats and the implementation package, and make sure the May 20 go-live still works on your side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, May 20 is still the target. We have 42 users confirmed now, but finance asked me to leave room for 6 more in Q3, so 48 seats is fine.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, great. The annual subscription comes to $38,400, and implementation is a one-time $6,000. I also added the standard support tier, not premium, since that’s what we discussed last week.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches my notes. On billing, can you do net 45? Our standard terms are net 45, and if it’s net 30 it just creates extra approval steps.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so net 45 is approved for this size. I’ll note that in the order form and make sure the billing tool reflects it before we send the final invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. And the contract start date would be May 1, right? Even though go-live is May 20?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. Start date May 1, 12-month term through April 30 next year. Implementation would kick off the week of May 6, with admin training on May 14.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. One thing, procurement asked if the renewal language has the 60-day notice period. They don’t want auto-renewal without notice.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, the current draft has 60 days’ written notice before renewal. I can send that section highlighted so your procurement team doesn’t have to dig for it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That would help. If you send the updated order form today, I can route it for signature tomorrow morning.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll update the CRM, generate the order form with 48 seats, net 45, May 1 start, and send it over by 3:00 Eastern.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, thanks. Once I have it, I’ll confirm the signer and get it moving.
